rationale: Two-stage auth bypass: (1) HAProxy ACL denies /api/v1/get_ticket but matches the path literally — appending `#` to the path bypasses the rule so the backend issues a JWT; (2) the JWT's `role` claim is tamperable to administrator, granting /api/v1/flag access. Both stages map to auth_bypass.
scanner_alignment: Logic specialist covers auth_bypass per SPECIALIST_VULN_MAP.
